$status: hypothesis — versioned; the DECLARED half of port-topology (golds provide the WITNESSED half). Revised as golds land.
$provenance: 4-panelist blind sweep (3 Opus + 1 full-slang), 2026-07-16; unanimous kinds/supergroups/axes; forks F1/F2/F3 human-ruled.

$forks_resolved.F1: a stem has ONE intrinsic kind; a supergroup is a VIEW that may span kinds (Structure spans EVENT+STATE). No orthogonal kind×supergroup matrix.
$forks_resolved.F2: a new Objects State supergroup homes bare object-consumes; Objects = fold(deployment − removal) = the §10 SDF-balance substrate.
$forks_resolved.F3: dice-rolled / damage-dealt / combat-presence are bare EVENT verbs, no supergroup.

kinds.EVENT: discrete occurrences with payloads — what subscriptions (triggered abilities) fire on.
kinds.STATE: pools/stores folded over the event stream (state = fold(events)).
kinds.BEHAVIOR: continuous time-varying values — statics, anthems, keyword grants, 'as long as'.

removal.def: a zone-change whose FROM endpoint is play (battlefield/stack): an object leaves play. Carries from/to/manner.

deployment.def: a zone-change whose TO endpoint is play: an object enters play (cast/ETB/token/reanimate/blink-return/copy).

modification.def: an object altered in place: P/T, keyword/ability grant, type/color/control change.

resources.def: fungible pools: mana, cards, life, counters.

objects.def: addressable permanents on the battlefield (F2). Objects = fold(deployment − removal). Bare object-consumes (a sac's fodder decrement) live here; the §10 balance substrate.

structure.def: the clock — a VIEW spanning phase/combat/extra-turn Events and tap/untap availability State (F1: a supergroup may span kinds).

dice-rolled.def: a die roll produces a numeric payload; feeds 'whenever you roll one or more dice' (O19 — dice dissolved, no fourth axis).

damage-dealt.def: damage as an event; edges into resources:life (loss) and, when lethal, removal (state-based death).

combat-presence.def: a permanent attacks or blocks (O21; the attacksorblocks subscription; emit:additionalcombat re-raises the phase that produces it).

stems_representative.$note: The is-a spine accretes via golds (status=witnessed there). These are the anchors per supergroup; parent derived by dropping the last ':' segment (permanent ⊃ creature). Witnesses are NEVER hand-listed here — TopologyStep recomputes them live from the golds (stems[*].witnesses in the rollup); a hand-typed list would silently drift from the growing gold set.

attribute_axes.$note: Closed key set (unordered per port). value = the observed lattice/enum; licensed_by = stems that may carry it (TFS appropriateness). 'provenance' (asserted|derived) and 'polarity' (fixed|producer-choice) are per-VALUE modifiers, not axes.

exclude_self.note: identity exclusion (:another); the attribute-axis key (matches the golds' attrs); the §6 guard rule id is guard:exclude-self (kebab, a different namespace)

self.note: the port's subject is the source object itself

aliases.$note: named attribute-constraints (O11); each pinned to exactly one query.

reject.$note: NOT AST-derivable — a game-plan/quality/social judgment, never a port. (A rejected archetype's MECHANISMS still map; the LABEL does not.)

holes.$note: DECLARED, status=witness:sought — the targeted-witnessing backlog (§8; ADR Migration Stage 0a). All six found blind by every panelist ⇒ structural, not slang-coverage artifacts. Ordered by corroboration; each seeds a search for a single-card/pairwise/combo witness for the first post-migration derivation run.

cost-modification.note: no cost-delta stem; both directions (↑ tax / ↓ reduction) homeless. Most corroborated (panel + full-slang + checklist).

restriction-grant.note: 'can't attack/block' grant — a Behavior with no stem.

prevention.note: a shield/replacement on the damage event.

library-search.note: library→hand by criteria; distinct from draw. A Cards-STATE op.

non-play-zone-move.note: the from→to primitive is play-anchored; hidden-zone↔hidden-zone moves fit neither Removal (from=play) nor Deployment (to=play). Do NOT force into Removal. Opus-3's 'real hole'. Scaffold reconciliation 2026-07-18: already witnessed by archaeomancer.json (recur stem, from=graveyard/to=hand) — proposed_stem updated from the placeholder 'zonechange (neither removal nor deployment)' to the landed stem name 'recur' so TopologyStep's literal proposed_stem match resolves this hole to witnessed; no new gold authored (would have duplicated archaeomancer.json).

connectivity_predictions.$note: falsifiable null hypotheses for the topology sweeps (rollup-vs-scaffold).
connectivity_predictions.P1: every emit:removal:*[manner=sacrificed] (sac outlet) reaches all three consumer rungs — 'when sacrificed', 'when dies' (removal:*[to=graveyard]), 'when leaves battlefield' (removal:*) — by subsumption.
connectivity_predictions.P2: every emit:deployment:creature[token] (token maker) reaches every consume:objects:creature (sac/fodder consumer) via the object store.
connectivity_predictions.P3: color is topology-invariant — it never appears on a stem, only as an attribute; a mono-U and a B/G combo have the same supergroup shape.
connectivity_predictions.P4: irreducible cross-resource bridges (structure:untap → mana) stay AMBER by ceiling.
connectivity_predictions.P5: a self-watching subscription (subject=self) fed by a broad emit ('a creature') tiers AMBER (Overlaps), never GREEN.
connectivity_predictions.P6: every one of the six holes has ≥1 witnessable card in the corpus (else the hole is a taxonomy error, not a coverage gap).
